_comment: Who runs the site, shown in the Privacy Notice, Cookie Policy and Terms. build.py fills them in. Check every value before the first deploy. mail_provider: the company whose mail server sends the sign-in codes, with its country (for example "Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France)"). speech_targets: the goals shown on the Progress page, as rough guides (how good a voice gets also depends on how Quenya-TTS trains); the first one must be minimum_training_minutes.
supervisory_authority: Commission nationale pour la protection des données (CNPD)

speech_targets.name: First test voice
speech_targets.about: Enough for the first training. A model that already speaks other languages adapts to Quenya: understandable, but rough.

speech_targets.name: A better voice
speech_targets.about: Clearly more natural, and fewer mistakes.

speech_targets.name: A natural voice
speech_targets.about: The goal: a voice that reads Quenya naturally. Several hours from the same volunteer help most.
